read_only_audit.independent_method: Rehashed 40 packed and 40 value payloads; independently unpacked the positive source planes; rebuilt 51,840,000 raw row-partition observations and 17,280 phases for each q; recomputed nearest-pattern work and all 16 timestamp recurrences without importing M358, M344, M339 or M43; checked every result against M358.

capacity_recompute.pattern_residence_witness: Reserve one q*2-byte immutable pattern region in slot0; load tile payloads into a disjoint slot0 tile region and the whole slot1 tile region. The maximum pattern-plus-tile footprint fits slot0 for every q/O pair.

recurrence_audit.per_phase_formula: pattern_dma + matcher + packer + first_tile_dma + (tiles-1)*max(tile_compute,next_tile_dma) + final_tile_compute + tail

wide144.reason: The candidate reads a 144-byte PWP vector per compute cycle versus the shared 96-byte port; this is a 1.5x candidate-only payload width and is not a fair headline.

systolic_q.q16: 16-distance-PE named architecture point; retain only as an unnormalized topology sensitivity

sensitivity_findings.full_descriptor_packer: M358 packs only assignment_rows although it reserves one 48-bit descriptor for every one of the 3000 rows. Charging 3000/8+4 packer cycles per phase lowers the preferred q32/O4 SHARED96+SERIAL16 estimate from 1.077553x to 1.067225x and q128/O1 from 0.997319x to 0.988776x.
sensitivity_findings.pwp_burst_alignment: The packed-byte DMA formula is exact for O8/O4/O2 because each PWP payload is a multiple of 32 bytes. If each q128 O1 144-byte vector occupies an independently rounded five-cycle burst, q128 SHARED96+SERIAL16 changes from 0.997319x to 0.995639x.
sensitivity_findings.interpretation: Neither sensitivity rescues q128 under the fair shared-port serial matcher. They strengthen q32/O4 as the implementation seed but do not supply missing descriptor ports or RTL cycles.

p1.title: Descriptor capacity is declared but descriptor service is not executable and the packer charges only PWP assignments
p1.impact: A 3000x48-bit bank implies one durable record per raw row, yet fallback-row writes, eight-output-block reads, bank arbitration and backpressure are absent. The preferred fair estimate drops from 1.077553x to 1.067225x under the simplest all-row write sensitivity.

p1.title: Two slots and one DMA are constructible but represented by a closed-form recurrence rather than finite state and queues
p1.impact: Independent timestamps prove a legal abstract ping-pong order, but address generation, request/response latency, SRAM ports, validity generations and capacity stalls are not simulated. M358 correctly leaves cycle_bound and RTL match false.

p1.title: Peak rows expand compute-port width or matcher PE count without area normalization
p1.impact: The 1.639256x peak combines WIDE144 with 128 distance PEs. It is an explicit-resource endpoint, not a same-resource accelerator comparison or DATE headline.

p2.title: Pattern physical address ownership is implicit
p2.impact: Capacity permits a valid one-copy construction by reserving q*2 bytes in slot0, but M358 does not emit that address map or prove tile DMA cannot overwrite it.

p2.title: Dynamic PWP gather and DRAM burst granularity are unspecified
p2.impact: Only q128/O1 changes under per-vector 32-byte burst rounding, but the eventual address-timed simulator must choose packed gathering or charge the 0.92-0.94 million-cycle sensitivity.

p2.title: M358 does not retain phase-level component or event traces
p2.impact: Independent diagnosis required a full 51.84-million-observation replay; retaining phase IDs and component timestamps would make future audits faster and localize contention.

p2.title: Common output accumulation and commit storage are only a terminal scalar charge
p2.impact: The 960,000 common commit cycles are fair across branches, but output-accumulator capacity, ports and overlap are outside this module recurrence and must stay outside executable/system claims.

go: admit M358's exact frozen work, one-pattern-DMA correction, four q/O capacity proofs and abstract two-slot/single-DMA/no-cross-phase constructive recurrence
retain all 16 rows as explicitly named analytical DSE points
use q32/O4 SHARED96+SERIAL16 as the preferred same-port/same-PE implementation seed
build descriptor-bank service and an address-timed finite-state module simulator before RTL cycle matching
run Synopsys DC throughput/mm2 Pareto for PE16/32/64/128 and 96-byte versus 144-byte ports only as explicit resource variants
no_go: admitting any M358 row as executable cycle, measured hardware, area-matched, energy, system speedup or DATE headline
presenting 1.639256x WIDE144+SYSTOLIC128 as a fair accelerator speedup
continuing q128/O1 SHARED96+SERIAL16 as the primary accelerator point because it is slower than baseline before missing descriptor service
calling the whole module 64 KiB; cache plus the declared descriptor banks is 101,536 bytes
verdict.next_step: GO a finite descriptor-aware q32/O4 SHARED96+SERIAL16 module scheduler with explicit slot/pattern addresses, one 32-B/cycle DMA queue, descriptor write/read ports, PWP gather bursts and zero-mismatch cycle comparison; NO-GO any headline promotion until that and equal-area Synopsys normalization pass.
